# Abertay University Research Knowledge Exchange

> > Abertay University's research repository showcasing doctoral and masters theses across health sciences, engineering, social sciences, and natural sciences.

The Research Knowledge Exchange (RKE) at Abertay University provides open access to student research outputs, including PhD and masters theses spanning diverse disciplines from psychology and healthcare to mechatronics, molecular biology, and mathematical theory. The repository demonstrates the university's commitment to knowledge dissemination and research excellence across multiple fields.

## Key Topics

- Abertay University
- Doctoral thesis
- Masters thesis
- Sense of Coherence
- Hardiness
- Psychological resilience
- Qualitative research
- Mechatronics
- National Health Service
- Clinical utility
- Case-based reasoning
- Confirmatory Factor Analysis
- Questionnaire validity
- Electronic design
- Personality assessment

## Health Sciences and Psychology

- [Investigation into the elements contributing to the constructs of sense of coherence and hardiness with particular reference to clinical utility](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/investigation-into-the-elements-contributing-to-the-constructs-of): Doctoral thesis on Sense of Coherence and Hardiness clinical utility
- [A mixed methods examination of attitudes and perceived mood change and well-being across the menstrual cycle](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/a-mixed-methods-examination-of-attitudes-and-perceived-mood-chang): Masters thesis on menstrual cycle mood changes and well-being
- [Design and development of novel tools for the screening and identification of inhibitors of HER receptor family and NFR2 for ovarian cancer therapy](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/design-and-development-of-novel-tools-for-the-screening-and-ident): PhD on HER receptor and NRF2 inhibitors for ovarian cancer therapy
- [An exploratory study of male ex-prisoners' experiences of health and healthcare in prison and the community](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/an-exploratory-study-of-male-ex-prisoners-experiences-of-health-a): Doctoral research on male ex-prisoners' healthcare experiences
- [The effects of short duration, combined sprint interval training on performance measures](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/the-effects-of-short-duration-combined-sprint-interval-training-o): Doctoral thesis on sprint interval training for combat sport performance
- [An embodied analysis of male rugby players' lived experiences of concussion](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/an-embodied-analysis-of-male-rugby-players-lived-experiences-of-c): Masters thesis on rugby players' concussion experiences and embodiment

## Engineering and Technology

- [Intelligent electronic design for mechatronic systems](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/intelligent-electronic-design-for-mechatronic-systems): PhD thesis on mechatronic electronic design using CBR and decomposition
- [The implementation of functional languages on an object-oriented architecture](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/the-implementation-of-functional-languages-on-an-object-oriented-): PhD on functional language implementation on Rekursiv architecture
- [Characterisation of molecular materials for electronic devices](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/characterisation-of-molecular-materials-for-electronic-devices): Doctoral research on organic semiconductor charge transport properties

## Natural Sciences and Mathematics

- [New asymptotic formulas for the Riemann zeta function](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/new-asymptotic-formulas-for-the-riemann-zeta-function): Doctoral thesis on Riemann zeta function asymptotic formulas
- [Structural studies on the iron storage protein, apoferritin](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/structural-studies-on-the-iron-storage-protein-apoferritin): PhD research on apoferritin protein structure using SDS-PAGE analysis
- [The development of a transparent soil and its application in imaging root trajectories and root bacteria interactions](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/the-development-of-a-transparent-soil-and-its-application-in-imag): Doctoral thesis on transparent soil for 3D root-bacteria imaging
- [Chemical and biological factors affecting the performance of CCA and ACA treated wood in soil](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/chemical-and-biological-factors-affecting-the-performance-of-cca-): Research on CCA/ACA wood preservation and copper leaching in soil
- [A systematic study of the effect of ultrasound on food enzymes and bioactives in model and real food systems (strawberry puree)](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/a-systematic-study-of-the-effect-of-ultrasound-on-food-enzymes-an): Doctoral thesis on ultrasound enzyme inactivation in strawberry puree

## Social Sciences and Law

- [Exploring perceptions of challenges in using personal online banking diffusion in Bangladesh](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/exploring-perceptions-of-challenges-in-using-personal-online-bank): Doctoral thesis on online banking adoption challenges in Bangladesh
- [The prospects for human germline genetic modification](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/the-prospects-for-human-germline-genetic-modification): PhD on human germline genetic modification ethics and techniques
- [Economic activity or public order limitations](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/economic-activity-or-public-order-limitations): PhD on prostitution regulation and human trafficking in EU law
- [The 'non-ideal' victim](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/the-non-ideal-victim): Research on sexual assault victim perceptions and rape myth acceptance

## Business and Management

- [Training and development in Libyan banks](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/training-and-development-in-libyan-banks): PhD on training effectiveness in Libyan banking sector
- [Corporate parenting and corporate-level strategy in integrated oil and gas industry](https://rke.abertay.ac.uk/en/studentTheses/corporate-parenting-and-corporate-level-strategy-in-integrated-oi): PhD on NNPC corporate strategy and value creation in oil/gas sector
